note: Technologies are listed only where they appear in the public portfolio. Non-portfolio glosses are dictionary-level definitions, not claims about HRB capability.

portfolioStack.name: Portfolio stack
portfolioStack.note: This portfolio itself is built with React, TypeScript and Vite.

techs.name: Python
techs.gloss: A general-purpose programming language. Listed among HRB Legal AI and HRB Legal Reader technologies.

techs.name: FastAPI
techs.gloss: A modern Python web framework for building APIs. Listed among HRB Legal AI technologies.

techs.name: PostgreSQL
techs.gloss: A relational database. Listed among HRB Legal AI technologies.

techs.name: pgvector
techs.gloss: A PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search, associated with grounded retrieval. Listed among HRB Legal AI technologies.

techs.name: RAG
techs.gloss: Retrieval-augmented generation — an approach that grounds AI answers in retrieved source material rather than relying on the model alone. Used in HRB Legal AI and HRB Legal Reader.

techs.name: Agentic AI
techs.gloss: AI systems and workflows that can act toward a goal across multiple steps rather than only responding to a single prompt. HRB Legal AI is described as an agentic legal AI platform.

techs.name: MCP
techs.gloss: Model Context Protocol — a standard for connecting models to tools and data. Listed among HRB Legal AI technologies.

techs.name: OCR
techs.gloss: Optical character recognition — converting images or scanned text into machine-readable text. Used in HRB Legal Reader for document processing.

techs.name: Document Intelligence
techs.gloss: Automated processing of documents to extract and understand their structure and content. The core focus of HRB Legal Reader.

techs.name: React
techs.gloss: A JavaScript library for building interfaces. Listed among HRB Digital Systems technologies and used to build this portfolio.

techs.name: TypeScript
techs.gloss: A typed superset of JavaScript. Listed among HRB Digital Systems technologies and used to build this portfolio.

techs.name: Vite
techs.gloss: A frontend build tool and development server. Listed among HRB Digital Systems technologies and used to build this portfolio.

techs.name: Automation
techs.gloss: Software that performs repeated or complex operations without manual steps. Listed among HRB Digital Systems technologies.

techs.name: System Architecture
techs.gloss: The structural design of how applications, data and services connect. Listed among HRB Digital Systems technologies.
